decisive_items: no monoclonal peak on serum or urine immunoelectrophoresis
response.rationale: Noncaseating granulomas, hypercalcemia with low PTH, polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia, and negative TB test strongly favor sarcoidosis; multiple myeloma is excluded by absent monoclonal peak and normal free light chains, hyperparathyroidism by low PTH, vitamin D toxicity lacks exposure history, and LCH lacks confirmatory pathology.

rejected.why: Low PTH (9 ng/L) contradicts primary hyperparathyroidism despite hypercalcemia.
Osteolytic lesions and hepatosplenic nodules are nonspecific; no biopsy evidence of Langerhans cells.
No vitamin D supplementation or elevated 25-OH vitamin D documented.
Absence of monoclonal peak and normal free light-chain ratio exclude multiple myeloma.
